name: Confluence and Normalization of the Guarded Kernel Fragment
description: Studies guarded SafeStep root and context closures. Every safe-fragment source is locally joinable and confluent with unique normal forms, while full Step fails at eqW void void.

program.name: The Confluence Axis
program.summary: The equality test eqW merges two copies of one term that differ only in place: the reflexive diagonal is the one root obstruction to confluence, the disequality guard that repairs it is the greatest conservative repair and is definable by no term of the signature, and the guarded relation terminates and has unique normal forms while the unguarded closure gives eqW void void two normal forms. For first-order rewriting, non-omega-overlap with right-hand-side determinedness gives unique normal forms under the Section 7 hypothesis of Kahrs and Smith, and a three-term counterexample refutes their Lemma 64, the step the published proof of Problem 79 rests on.

oneLine: Every guarded SafeStep source is locally joinable and confluent with unique normal forms, while full Step fails local joinability at eqW void void.
summary: The theory studies the Trace term language with void, delta, integrate, merge, app, recDelta and eqW and two root relations, the full kernel Step with eight unconditional rules and the guarded SafeStep with deltaFlag and kappaM guards, together with their reflexive-transitive and contextual closures. It asks which fragment is locally joinable, confluent and normalizing and where the full kernel fails. Every SafeStep source is locally joinable by exhaustive case analysis, and termination by strictly decreasing ctxFuel plus Newman induction gives unconditional confluence for SafeStep and its context closure with reachable normal forms and unique normal forms. A computable safe normalizer reaches a safe normal form for every trace. On the other side full Step is not locally joinable at eqW void void because overlapping eqW rules give distinct normal forms, and its full context closure reaches two distinct irreducible traces void and integrate void so it is neither locally confluent nor confluent and admits no invariant normalizer. All positive confluence and normalization claims hold for the guarded safe fragment only.
boundary: On the guarded SafeStep side every source is locally joinable and the root and context closures are confluent with unique normal forms. On the full Step side this fails at eqW void void, where the eqW reflexive and difference rules overlap to give distinct normal-form reducts, contextually void and integrate void. The obstruction is this diagonal eqW overlap, located by the theorems denying LocalJoinStep at eqW void void and denying local confluence, confluence and invariant normalization for the full context closure while affirming them for SafeStep.

conclusions.statement: Unconditionally, the safe star closure is confluent (ConfluentSafe holds).
Unconditionally, the safe fragment has unique normal forms.
For every trace a, LocalJoinSafe a holds.
Unconditionally, the context-closed SafeStepCtxStar is confluent (ConfluentSafeCtx holds).
For every trace a, LocalJoinCtxAt a holds.
ConfluentSafeCtx holds if and only if every trace a satisfies LocalJoinCtxAt a.
For every trace t, there exists a trace n with SafeStepCtxStar t n and NormalFormSafeCtx n.
For all traces a and b, if SafeStepCtx a b then ctxFuel b is strictly less than ctxFuel a.
The reverse relation fun a b => SafeStepCtx b a is well-founded.
It is not the case that LocalJoinStep (eqW void void) holds.
CtxStar (eqW void void) void and CtxStar (eqW void void) (integrate void) hold, void and integrate void have no StepCtxFull successors, and void is not equal to integrate void.
It is not the case that StepCtxFull is abstractly locally confluent.
It is not the case that StepCtxFull is abstractly confluent.
There is no function nf from Trace to Trace that is invariant under StepCtxFull steps and fixes every StepCtxFull normal form.
For all traces a and b, if NormalForm a holds and StepStar a b holds then a equals b.

openPoints: Newman confluence lemmas carry the everywhere-local-join hypothesis that every source is locally joinable, discharged for SafeStep by the exhaustive local-join proof.

All positive local-joinability, confluence and normalization results hold for the guarded SafeStep and SafeStepCtx fragment only and claim nothing about full Step beyond the eqW void void counterexamples.
Strong normalization by strictly decreasing ctxFuel applies to SafeStepCtx steps only, while full contextual termination uses the separate polynomial witness W.

files.summary: The file defines the Trace term language with seven constructors and the full Step root relation with eight unconditional rules. It defines the reflexive-transitive closure StepStar and the predicate NormalForm for terms with no outgoing Step. It proves transitivity of StepStar, that a single Step gives StepStar, and that a StepStar path from a normal form must be trivial.
files.conclusion: Any multi-step reduction starting from a normal form ends at the same term.

files.summary: This file defines local-join predicates for the safe fragment and the full kernel Step. It proves many safe root-shape cases by uniqueness or vacuity and discharges the global claim that every safe source is locally joinable, with lifts to context closure. It records the caveat that full kernel Step is not locally joinable at eqW void void due to overlapping eqW rules.
files.conclusion: Every safe-fragment source is locally joinable, while full kernel Step is not locally confluent at eqW void void.

files.summary: This file proves the full contextual relation StepCtxFull is neither locally confluent nor confluent. It shows integrate void is contextually normal and exhibits eqW void void reaching both void and integrate void as distinct contextual normal forms. It concludes that no function can both identify contextual steps and fix normal forms.
files.conclusion: The full context closure has one source with two distinct normal forms, so it is neither locally confluent nor confluent and admits no invariant normalizer.

files.summary: This file proves unconditional strong normalization for the selected-context closure of the safe fragment. It defines the reverse relation SafeStepCtxRev and the numeric interpretation ctxFuel with constructor-wise accessibility lemmas. It shows ctxFuel strictly decreases on safe root and contextual steps, yielding well-foundedness and accessibility for all traces and discharging the recursor obligation.
files.conclusion: The reverse selected-context safe relation is well-founded through strictly decreasing ctxFuel, so every trace is accessible.

files.summary: This file defines the full context closure StepCtxFull of the unguarded kernel relation and its reverse. It lifts the root polynomial orientation to show the nonlinear witness W strictly decreases on every contextual step. The decrease gives full context-closed strong normalization via reduction to Nat.lt.
files.conclusion: The full unguarded contextual relation is strongly normalizing because the polynomial witness W decreases on every step.

files.summary: This file separates delta thaw for EqGuardedStep from delta blocking in SafeStep. It proves freezing only eqW already enables delta congruence and is confluent, and that EqGuardedStep confluence never constrains delta. It characterizes deltaFlag one as the recursor-successor shape, contrasts guarded SafeStep merge with unconditional Step merge, and names contextual SafeStep with delta congruence as the remaining conjecture.
files.conclusion: Delta thaw preserves EqGuardedStep confluence while SafeStep delta blocking is a distinct measure-forced guard leaving a named contextual conjecture.

files.summary: The file packages the already proved strong normalization, everywhere local joinability, and Newman conclusions for SafeStep and its context closure under stable distinction-axis names. It records Newman provenance explicitly and states unique normal forms and the context-closure equivalence. It bridges these to the completeness result that the full kernel fails only on the eqW reflexive diagonal, so the guard removes exactly that obstruction.
files.conclusion: SafeStep is globally confluent and its guard removes exactly the unique eqW-diagonal obstruction of the full kernel.

files.summary: Defines certified one-step root and contextual reduct enumerators for Step and StepCtxFull and proves soundness and completeness against the inductive relations. Defines bounded delta-head search with unconditional soundness and completeness under an explicit fuel bound transported from the polynomial witness W. Composes the Bool with the diagonal join characterization to decide classifier verdicts on the fueled region, with closed-term evaluations by rfl.
files.conclusion: One-step contextual enumeration is exactly StepCtxFull and bounded delta-head search is sound always and complete at fuel W.

files.summary: The file isolates an eqW-guarded fragment that keeps all full KO7 root rules but allows the eqW diff branch only on distinct arguments. It shows the fragment sits between SafeStep and full Step and is root-deterministic. It inherits termination from the full-step interpretation and strictly extends SafeStep. Local joinability plus well-founded induction prove the fragment confluent.
files.conclusion: The eqW-guarded fragment strictly between SafeStep and full Step is terminating and confluent by uniqueness of targets and Newman induction.

files.summary: The file shows integrate of merge a a is a full-step normal form and void is distinct from it. It proves the unguarded eqW a a overlap with reducts void and integrate of merge is never locally joinable. It names this failure guard necessity. It re-exports the three facts under namespace-stable aliases.
files.conclusion: In the full unguarded kernel relation the eqW a a overlap is never locally joinable because it has two distinct normal-form reducts.

files.summary: This file proves Newman's lemma for the guarded safe relation by Acc recursion, joining stars via root local joins. It packages termination from the computable measure with a local-join hypothesis to obtain confluence. It derives parameterized and unconditional unique-normal-form, normalizer-uniqueness and stability corollaries, plus decidability of reachability to a safe normal form.
files.conclusion: The safe fragment is confluent with unique normal forms and a stable normalizer, and reachability to a safe normal form is decidable.

files.summary: This file adds an executable cost model counting deterministic root contractions alongside the certified safe normalizer. It defines the left-nested merge-void spine and shows it contracts to void in exactly n root steps. It proves the normalizer returns void with counted cost exactly n, giving the stated linear lower bound.
files.conclusion: Certified normalization on the merge-void chain costs exactly n, hence at least n.

files.summary: This file defines the safe star closure, safe normal forms and a deterministic witness selector with no-step soundness. It builds a computable certified normalizer by well-founded recursion with reachability and normal-form certificates. It proves fixed-point characterizations, progress lemmas, idempotence and bundled soundness and totality for SafeStep only.
files.conclusion: Every trace safely normalizes to a unique safe normal form via a computable certified normalizer.

files.summary: The file develops confluence from termination plus unique normal forms for arbitrary relations and first-order rewriting systems, with both directions for terminating systems. It gives transport theorems that move termination via stuttering simulation and uniqueness via faithful simulation to the source. A three-state source maps non-injectively onto a two-state target to obtain confluence, while a terminating fork is not confluent so uniqueness is necessary.
files.conclusion: Terminating relations and systems with unique normal forms are confluent, transported across simulations and sharp without uniqueness.

files.summary: This file closes the two-rule free recursor under one-hole contexts and proves every step strictly decreases a root-weight measure, giving well-founded termination. It defines evaluation of the recursor counter and a normalizer, proves every term reaches its normal form and normal forms are step-free and unique. It concludes confluence, a joinability-by-normal-form-equality characterization with a Boolean decision procedure, and an example separating contextual from root steps.
files.conclusion: Contextual closure of the two-rule recursor terminates, is confluent with unique normal forms, and has decidable joinability by normal-form equality.

files.summary: This file defines a Boolean-parameterized root-step function for the unguarded KO7 relation and proves it sound and complete with respect to Step. It builds a ranked machine and normalizer with reachability, normality, idempotence and cost bounded by the polynomial weight. It computes both Boolean normal forms of eqW void void and proves they differ, so root normalization depends on strategy.
files.conclusion: Root normalization depends on the Boolean strategy, with distinct normal forms for eqW void void.

files.summary: This file contains no new definitions or theorems and only imports the seven SafeStep gauge-fixing modules as one namespace surface. It documents the canonical citation chain from payload discarding through the EqW anomaly, guard, non-derivability, smuggling and functor results. It lists audit anchors pointing to the local-confluence, guard-restoration, fracture and non-faithfulness theorems proved elsewhere.
files.conclusion: The file provides a single import surface with no additional declarations.

files.summary: This file factors SafeStepCtx confluence into strong normalization and an exhaustive local-join case analysis with normal-form existence and preservation lemmas. It proves every term has a normal form with zero delta flag and that zero kappa is preserved along steps and multi-steps. It establishes Newman lemma, the equivalence between confluence and everywhere local joinability, and unconditional confluence.
files.conclusion: SafeStepCtx is unconditionally confluent via strong normalization plus exhaustive local joinability.

files.summary: This file defines a computable weight and multiset payload kappaM for KO7 traces and a binary deltaFlag, together with simp equations for each trace constructor. It proves well-foundedness of the Dershowitz-Manna order on multisets of naturals and extension lemmas that enlarge a multiset while staying larger in that order. It then defines the guarded root relation SafeStep with eight rules for integrate, merge, recursor and equality witnesses, and its reverse SafeStepRev for strong-normalization statements.
files.conclusion: The file establishes the guarded SafeStep root relation together with a well-founded Dershowitz-Manna payload that can orient its steps.

files.summary: This file defines SafeStepCtx as the one-step contextual closure of SafeStep and SafeStepCtxStar as its reflexive-transitive closure, with lifting lemmas through integrate, merge, app and recursor arguments. It defines LocalJoinSafe_ctx for joins after two root steps and proves vacuous or unique joins for shapes with zero or one applicable root rule, including void, delta, app, integrate and recursor cases. It then proves conditional joins for the eqW reflexive peak that require a merge-to-delta or normalize-to-delta premise with cancel guards.
files.conclusion: The file reduces context-closed local joins for the safe fragment to vacuous or unique cases plus explicit merge-to-delta conditions for the reflexive equality peak.

files.summary: This file defines a small synthesis-oracle interface that returns a concrete barrier certificate for a candidate direct measure. It packages candidate types for transparent-compositional and affine-with-pump measures and defines certificate-side values with a changes-at-certificate predicate. It proves that any refinement succeeding on the returned triple must change at least one certificate side. It instantiates the interface with additive, transparent-compositional, affine, and automatic affine-with-pump oracles.
files.conclusion: Any refinement that succeeds on the oracle certificate triple must change at least one certificate-side value.

files.summary: This file is a permanent reach and axiom audit for ConfluenceTransport. It checks relation confluence, normal-form lemmas, well-founded unique-normal characterizations, transport lemmas, terminating-confluent equivalences, and TriStep DuoStep simulations. It proves no new content and only audits the transport surface.
files.conclusion: Confluence transports across simulations given well-foundedness and unique normals with tri-step confluence by transport.

files.summary: This file checks non-confluence under full step-context closure. It checks failure of local confluence and confluence, void-context normality, two normal forms and absence of an invariant normalizer. It audits axioms for each checked declaration.
files.conclusion: Context-full closure is non-confluent with two normal forms and no invariant normalizer.

files.summary: This file audits FreeRecursorContext with declaration, axiom and execution checks. It checks contexts, fill and composition, steps in context, well-foundedness, normalization, confluence, unique normal forms and decidable joinability. It also proves eight examples by rfl, decide and applications of reachability, confluence and normalization certificates.
files.conclusion: All FreeRecursorContext declarations elaborate and the concrete normalization and joinability evaluations hold.

files.summary: This file checks reachability of root-strategy normalization. It runs paired #check and #print axioms for root stepping with soundness and completeness, the root machine, normalization with reachability, normality, idempotence, cost bounds, choice variants and strategy dependence. It proves no new content.
files.conclusion: The file pins sound and complete root normalization with strategy dependence.

files.summary: This file performs a minimal compilation check with no theorems. It evaluates 1 plus 1 and checks Prod.Lex. It contributes no theorem content, as its own docstring states.
files.conclusion: The file checks that a trivial evaluation and Prod.Lex elaborate with no theorem content.
